operations.claim: write through p into command buffer
write through p into command buffer
format delegate command into fixed-size buffer

states.claim: image is an acquired Image object; OpenBlob is called on it and it is destroyed on failure paths.
input_filename holds a unique symbolic link path created from image_info->filename; it is later relinquished.
p points into the command buffer; command is zero-initialized and p is reset to command after each token.
image blob is closed after reading PCL elements.
density and options are allocated strings; both are destroyed after use.
image is destroyed before cloning read_info.
read_info is a cloned ImageInfo; its magick field is cleared and it is destroyed after use.
read_info->filename is replaced with a unique filename after the original filename is copied to filename; the unique file resource is relinquished.
image is reassigned from ReadImage; if NULL, a reader exception is thrown.
If image magick is BMP, ConsolidateCMYKImages may return cmyk_image; on success image is destroyed and replaced by cmyk_image.
image is advanced through the image list via SyncNextImageInList until the last image.

values.claim: p starts at command and is incremented by one byte per input character; the buffer is flushed when (size_t)(p-command) >= MaxTextExtent-1, so at most MaxTextExtent-1 bytes are written before the terminating NUL at *p.
width is computed as (size_t) CastDoubleToLong(floor(bounds.x2-bounds.x1+0.5)), converting the double difference of the parsed crop/media box x coordinates to a size_t.
height is computed as (size_t) CastDoubleToLong(floor(bounds.y2-bounds.y1+0.5)), converting the double difference of the parsed crop/media box y coordinates to a size_t.
page.width is updated to width only when width > page.width, so page.width is the maximum width seen across parsed boxes.
page.height is updated to height only when height > page.height, so page.height is the maximum height seen across parsed boxes.
page.width and page.height are rescaled by image resolution divided by delta (DefaultResolution) with floor(x+0.5) and cast to size_t before being formatted into the delegate geometry option.
geometry is formatted as "%.20gx%.20g" from the rescaled page.width and page.height.
options is formatted as "-g%.20gx%.20g " from the rescaled page.width and page.height.
density is formatted as "%gx%g" from image->x_resolution and image->y_resolution.
When image_info->ping is true, density is overwritten with the literal "2.0x2.0" using MagickPathExtent as the size limit.
command is formatted with the delegate command template and arguments: antialias ? 4 : 1 twice, density, options, read_info->filename, and input_filename.

values.claim: filename is copied from read_info->filename with a MaxTextExtent bound before read_info->filename is replaced by a unique filename.
When image_info->ping is true, image->magick_columns, image->magick_rows, image->columns, and image->rows are each multiplied by the corresponding resolution divided by 2.0.
count is assigned the sscanf return value for CropBox/MediaBox parsing of four doubles into bounds.x1, bounds.y1, bounds.x2, bounds.y2; only count == 4 proceeds to geometry computation.

executions.claim: If image_info->page is non-NULL, the PCL element scanning loop skips all parsing, so page.width and page.height remain 0 until later overridden by ParseAbsoluteGeometry(image_info->page,&page).

Inside the scanning loop, *p++ is written before the buffer-full check; the check only continues when c is not '/' and not '\n' and (p-command) < MaxTextExtent-1, so reaching *p='\0' implies either c is '/' or '\n', or the buffer is full.
After the CropBox/MediaBox parsing blocks, continuing past L148 implies count == 4, meaning bounds.x1, bounds.y1, bounds.x2, bounds.y2 were successfully assigned by sscanf.

executions.claim: When count == 4, width and height are computed from bounds.x2-bounds.x1 and bounds.y2-bounds.y1 via floor and CastDoubleToLong, then cast to size_t.
page.width and page.height are monotonically increased to the maximum observed width and height across parsed boxes.
After the scan loop, if page.width or page.height is 0, page is set from PSPageGeometry; then if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is overwritten from image_info->page.
delegate_info is selected based on image_info->monochrome, then cmyk, else color; if NULL, the function returns NULL.
After delegate selection, page.width and page.height are again defaulted from PSPageGeometry if zero and overridden by image_info->page if non-NULL.
page.width and page.height are scaled by image->x_resolution/delta.x and image->y_resolution/delta.y respectively, with floor and +0.5 rounding, then cast to size_t.
If read_info->number_scenes != 0, options is overwritten with -dLastPage or -dFirstPage/-dLastPage based on whether number_scenes == 1, then number_scenes is reset to 0.
